from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class IncomeTaxExpense(BaseModel):
    """Income tax expense reported in a single quarterly financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name the report belongs to")
    period_year: str | None = Field(description="The year of the report, e.g. '2021'")
    period_quarter: str | None = Field(description="The quarter, e.g. 'Q1' or '1-3月'")
    income_tax_expense: float | None = Field(description="The income tax expense amount")
    expense_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency/unit, e.g. '元'")
    year_over_year_change_percent: float | None = Field(description="Year-over-year change percentage if stated, e.g. 46.06 for 46.06%")
    reason_for_change: str | None = Field(description="The reason given for the tax expense change, if any")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short excerpt from the report anchoring this data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    income_tax_expenses: list[IncomeTaxExpense]
